studio.title: AI Studio
studio.intro: Create a branching academic scenario from course materials in just 3 steps.
studio.modeBranching: Branching Study · Decision tree — Students keep making choices and consequences stay hidden until the outcome. Recommended for incident scenarios.
studio.modeReview: Review Study · In-depth analysis — A simpler format: context, data and a problem to analyse. No decision tree needed.
studio.modeManual: Create manually from scratch — No AI; the lecturer writes the whole situation.
studio.modeUnavailable: The system can currently only generate Branching Study cases.
